Conditions (all must be true):
- Color ≠ cyan
- Size ≠ extra-extra-large
- Material ≠ steel
- Smell ≠ citrus fruits
- Origin ≠ Canadian

Items satisfying all conditions:

- Item 12 & 12 copy: size is extra-extra-large ✗
